component.name: CodeDesk
component.summary: Open-source remote workspace for development machines

description.p: CodeDesk is an independent open-source remote workspace based on the open-source RustDesk client and RustDesk Server OSS projects.

ul.li: Control Windows, macOS, and Linux development machines from desktop or mobile devices.
Use remote desktop, file transfer, clipboard, port forwarding, and persistent terminal capabilities.
Self-host the rendezvous and relay services.

description.p: Coding Workspace and AI coding workflow integrations are planned and are not part of the current baseline.
